vo-01-title: Bona Fide. Proof that a market maker kept its word.
vo-02-problem: Token projects lend their treasury to market makers, and then they hope. Proving the deal was kept usually means handing over your order book.
vo-03-landing: Bona Fide scores the deal inside sealed hardware. The book never leaves the enclave. Only the verdict does.
vo-04-directory: Every market maker, every epoch scored, in public.
vo-05-pass: This is an honest mandate. Spread, depth, uptime and loan discipline, measured every epoch and signed on chain.
vo-06-fail: And this one broke. The market maker dumped loaned tokens, so the epoch fails on loan cap. The record is permanent, and append only.
vo-07-keycheck: Before the first read, the enclave asks the exchange what the key is allowed to do. A key that can trade or withdraw is rejected on sight.
vo-08-readonly: Most agentic finance is about safely letting an agent spend. This one never spends. The fund movement attack surface is gone, not guarded.
vo-09-terminal: You do not have to take our word for any of it. Clone the repository and run the scorer yourself. Same code, same verdicts, no wallet and no exchange account.
vo-10-attest: The live agent runs inside Intel TDX on Phala Cloud. The contract verifies the hardware quote, and accepts verdicts only from code whose measurements are approved on chain.
vo-11-closing: AI may propose. Deterministic code decides. And the log cannot be quietly edited.
vo-12-end: Bona Fide. Built at the NEAR hackathon, and live on testnet.
